description: Says whether a deck in Toronto needs a building permit, whether a guard is required, the minimum guard height, opening size and stair handrail rule, from the City of Toronto and Ontario Building Code Part 9. Preliminary planning only. Example: /api/tools/deck-permit-and-guard-checker-toronto?units=mm&height=900&attached=yes&roofed=no&exit=no&risers=4&guard_height=900&gap=90

attached.description: The deck is attached to the house

exit.description: The deck forms part of an exit required under the Building Code

gap.description: Planned clear opening between pickets or balusters (units)

height.description: Height of the finished deck surface above the adjacent finished grade (units)

risers.description: Number of risers on the deck stairs (whole number)

units.description: Units of height, guard height and gap

name: deck-permit-and-guard-checker-toronto
title: Deck permit and guard checker for Toronto
